title: TransitionArchitecture
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a formally defined intermediate architecture state between the Baseline Architecture and the Target Architecture. Represents a planned waypoint in the architecture evolution roadmap. Placed in unclassified/ for GSM placement deliberation: may be a directive (target state specification), a governance record, or a state-plane snapshot definition. TOGAF mapping: Transition Architecture (ADM Phase E/F, Migration Planning). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Migration Planning).

sequenceOrder.description: Position in the transition sequence (1 = first transition from baseline). TOGAF mapping: Transition Architecture ordering in migration roadmap.

targetState.description: Architecture state classification. BASELINE = current as-is. TRANSITION = intermediate planned state. TARGET = final to-be. TOGAF mapping: Architecture state in roadmap.

plannedDuration.description: Planned duration for this transition as ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'P6M' for six months). TOGAF mapping: Migration Planning timeline.
